banking77.resolution: At n=250 and ~85% accuracy, the 95% Wilson interval is +/-4.4%. Two models closer than roughly 8.9% apart cannot be separated by unpaired comparison on this set. Paired tests (McNemar) do better because they use only the items where the models disagree.
